meta.name: board-memo
meta.description: Draft a board or executive summary of an engagement using outcomes, risks and investment decisions. Use when the sponsor needs to brief senior leadership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目成果、风险与投入决策整理成一份给高层看的简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目结束后要向管理层或投资人总结成果与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn engagement outcomes, risks, and investment decisions into a board-ready summary
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must brief senior leadership on results and risks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用成果、风险、投资决策这三块内容,替你起草某次合作项目的董事会或高管层摘要。动笔前它先读任务上下文约定和方法参考文件。
howto.when: 当项目赞助人需要向董事会或高管层汇报、需要一份执行摘要时接管;被 @fde 调用时复用其已有的脱敏信息包和范围,不重新开始。

say.text: 帮我起草这次合作的董事会摘要,涵盖成果、风险和投资决策。
say.note: 会先读任务上下文约定和方法文件再动笔。

say.text: 把这份材料整理成给高管层看的执行摘要。
say.note: 输出成果、风险与投资决策三部分。

say.text: 以 @fde 当前的脱敏信息包为准,直接写董事会摘要。
say.note: 复用已答内容,不重新提问。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drafts a board or executive summary of an engagement covering outcomes, risks and investment decisions. It first reads the task context contract and the method reference files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a sponsor needs to brief senior leadership; when called by @fde it reuses that run's current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Draft a board summary of this engagement: outcomes, risks, decisions.
say_en.note: Reads task context contract and method first.

say_en.text: Turn this into an executive summary for senior leadership.
say_en.note: Covers outcomes, risks and investment decisions.

say_en.text: Use @fde's current sanitized packet and write the board memo.
